digest.component_or_area: LLM framework CLI, library, and MCP interfaces
propositions: Remove three deprecated single-pass review public entry points: CLI verb 'rebar review', library function 'rebar.llm.review_ticket', and MCP tool 'review_ticket', all shipped in v0.11.0 and marked for pre-1.0 removal pass #3

Preserve the internal engine '_review_ticket_impl' and its two live consumers in review_workflows.py and eval_solver.py, and preserve review_result.schema.json by re-pointing its schema-wiring key from 'review_ticket' to 'review_code'
Update deprecation registry by deleting three _scheduled rows from src/rebar/_deprecations.py and recording the removal in the historical-record NOTE block

Regenerate public-facing documentation (CLI reference, MCP reference, and hand-written docs) to remove all mention of the three removed surfaces and ensure generated files match their authoritative scripts
